function: Learned joint subchannel allocation, transmit power control and propulsion (trajectory) of AAV relays between satellites and vehicles, maximizing energy efficiency (p. 6-7).
system: NOMA downlink; AAVs with NA antennas, single-antenna vehicles, 2 satellites, 2-5 AAVs, 100-200 vehicles; 2 GHz carrier, 10 MHz bandwidth; no RIS (p. 3, 9).
method: Multiagent DDPG (MADDPG) reinforcement learning, actor-critic with two hidden layers, centralized training and decentralized execution, 2000 training episodes (p. 8-9).
data_channel: Custom Python simulator built on the urban case of 3GPP TR 36.885 [43]: path loss 128.1+37.6log10(d), log-normal shadowing, Rayleigh fading; no dataset or measurements (p. 9, 12).
test_conditions: Trained on 2000 episodes of 100 steps; evaluated by sweeping AAVs (2-5), vehicles, SINR threshold, flight altitude; train/test conditions not distinguished (p. 9-11).
baselines: SGU Stackelberg game [46]; 2DP [44], APO [45], 3DP, NUA with restricted decision variables or no AAV; paper never names a learned baseline (p. 9).
metrics: Average energy efficiency (sum rate per unit power, bits/Hz/J) and probability of failure (SINR below threshold) (p. 5, 9-11).
complexity: none; only a qualitative remark that training is computationally intensive (p. 8); O(.) on p. 7 is the tabular Q-learning action space, not ERDM's cost.
openness: none (custom Python simulator, no code or data link; p. 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "The process of evaluation for the urban case described in [43] is used to construct the simulator." Reference [43] is p. 12: "Rep. TR 36.885" (3GPP LTE-based V2X); not a 38.901 or 38.811 model, so flagged in notes.
q2_support: p. 9: "we introduce varying numbers of AAVs from two to five while maintaining the same number and configurations of satellites and vehicles". Sweeps over AAVs, vehicles, SINR threshold and altitude are reported (p. 9-11), but the paper never says a policy trained in one setting is tested in another, or whether it is retrained per setting.
q3_support: p. 9: "SGU: Stackelberg Game-Based AAV-assisted joint resource allocation [46]." is the only external non-learned baseline. 2DP, APO, 3DP and NUA only restrict the decision variables or remove the AAVs (NUA: "we apply this approach with the same learning parameters and settings"). Missing: an earlier learned method or DQN/DDPG baseline.
q4_support: p. 8: "this training process is relatively computationally intensive to run over many episodes" is qualitative only. Missing: FLOPs, parameter counts or runtime; the O(.) on p. 7 ("the practical complexity manifests through an explosive growth in action space dimensionality") is the tabular Q-learning action space, not the cost of ERDM.
q5_support: p. 9: "Our implementation, simulated using Python" is a custom simulator. Missing: any code or data link or DOI, and any public channel dataset or measured data.
notes: Included as area 6: the learned MADDPG sets subchannel and power allocation and the propulsion of AAV relays; learned power and resource control in aerial links is physical layer and the trajectory is learned jointly, so above_phy does not apply (user association is non-learned, Algorithm 1, p. 6). q1 marked 1 under the another-standardized-model rule: 3GPP TR 36.885 (LTE-based V2X, ref. [43], p. 9 and 12), a terrestrial urban model applied to AAV links; reviewer to confirm. q3 is 0 because the paper never states that 2DP [44] or APO [45] are earlier learned methods; reviewer may check refs [44] and [45].
